items.followUp: What is the role of hydrochloric acid in the stomach?

rubric.why: Identifies that HCl changes inactive pepsinogen into active pepsin.
rubric.description: HCl activates pepsinogen to form pepsin
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that HCl activates or converts pepsinogen into pepsin.

rubric.why: States the acidic conditions needed for pepsin's action.
rubric.description: HCl provides the acidic medium in which pepsin works
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that HCl provides an acidic medium or suitable pH for pepsin.

modelAnswer: Hydrochloric acid activates pepsinogen and converts it into active pepsin.
It also provides the acidic medium required for pepsin to work.
